answer: Sybil fleets die in a knockout attestation bracket. Each epoch admits 64 answers to a single-elimination tree, one entry per address. Judges vote blind via a prism hash stripping authorship; beacon pairings reveal only after both lock, so clones cannot pick soft opponents. A bridge clause lets one eliminated entry reenter next epoch at triple fee; paired entries sharing a funding address are voided. Fees follow a canyon curve, 0.5% doubling to 16% by round six. N clones yield N·2^-6 survivors: cost is linear, four finalists split emission; one strong answer beats forty.
